For the year ended September 30, 2007, two customers accounted for approximately 16% and 11% of the
Company’s net sales, respectively. For the year ended September 30, 2006, two customers accounted for
approximately 10% and 9% of the Company’s net sales, respectively. For the year ended September 30, 2005,
three customers accounted for approximately 11%, 10% and 9% of the Company’s net sales, respectively. Export
sales to customers, primarily in Western Europe, Canada and Asia, were $143.0 million during fiscal 2007,
$102.7 million during fiscal 2006 and $81.5 million during fiscal 2005.
